categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main business segments: pesticide business and new materials business. The pesticide segment includes the production and sales of pesticide intermediates, technical pesticides (active ingredients), and pesticide formulations, with a focus on the herbicide dimethenamid-P. The new materials segment focuses on C5 chemical products derived from petrochemical by-products, including ketones and cyclopentane derivatives. Additionally, the company has a significant overseas pesticide export business through its subsidiary Ningbo Jielike.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced continuous nitrification and synthesis technologies for pesticide intermediates and active ingredients, with proprietary patents supporting production processes. It employs automated and centralized control systems for pesticide technical production, achieving high purity and low impurity levels meeting international standards. In new materials, the company uses hydrogenation, esterification, and dehydration chemical reactions to produce C5 ketones and olefins, with ongoing R&D in high-end C5 materials like cycloolefin copolymers. The company also emphasizes digitalization, intelligent manufacturing, and environmental protection technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international pesticide manufacturers, agrochemical formulators, and agricultural product distributors. The pesticide products serve broad agricultural applications including crops like cotton, corn, rice, vegetables, and fruits. The export business covers over 79 countries, focusing on developing regions along the Belt and Road Initiative. New materials customers are mainly chemical manufacturers requiring C5 derivatives for adhesives, coatings, synthetic rubber, and fine chemicals. The company maintains stable relationships with major global agrochemical companies and distributors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Zhejiang, Jiangsu, and Anhui provinces. Its overseas business spans Asia, Africa, Latin America, Europe, and North America through subsidiaries and export channels. Key export markets include countries in Latin America (Brazil, Argentina, Mexico), Africa (Ghana, Kenya), Asia (India, Pakistan), and Europe. The company also has subsidiaries and joint ventures in Hong Kong and multiple countries for pesticide registration and sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the upstream, midstream, and downstream segments of the pesticide supply chain. It produces raw materials and intermediates (upstream), synthesizes technical pesticides (midstream), and formulates pesticide products (downstream). In new materials, it produces chemical intermediates and specialty chemicals. The company also engages in downstream export and distribution activities through its trading subsidiaries, acting as a bridge between domestic manufacturers and international markets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the full pesticide industry chain with focus on environmentally friendly, high-efficiency, low-toxicity products like dimethenamid-P. The company invests heavily in R&D to improve production processes, product quality, and develop new pesticide formulations and C5 specialty chemicals. It is expanding its C5 new materials business through capacity additions and downstream product development such as cycloolefin copolymers. Digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, and environmental compliance are key innovation themes. The company also focuses on expanding overseas pesticide registrations and markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of pesticide intermediates, technical pesticides, pesticide formulations, and C5 chemical products. The company also earns revenue from international pesticide exports and trading activities. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distributor networks domestically, and through export contracts and overseas subsidiaries internationally. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing models but focuses on manufacturing and trading revenues.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the dimethenamid-P pesticide segment in China, holding approximately 70% domestic market share. It competes with other domestic pesticide manufacturers and benefits from its full industry chain integration and technology advantages. In the global pesticide market, it faces competition from multinational agrochemical giants but leverages cost and quality advantages to serve developing markets. In the C5 new materials sector, the company is a domestic pioneer with significant import substitution potential, competing against established international chemical companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately RMB 1.33 billion, nearly doubling from the previous year, driven by the full-year inclusion of the acquired trading subsidiary and new product sales. However, net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 32.86 million due to startup losses in new material projects and inventory destocking in pesticides. Total assets reached about RMB 3.16 billion, with steady growth in fixed assets and investments. The company is in a growth phase, expanding capacity and markets, with increased R&D and capital expenditures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its full industry chain integration from raw materials to formulations, enabling cost control, quality consistency, and supply stability. Its proprietary continuous production technologies and high-purity pesticide products meet stringent international standards, differentiating it from competitors. The environmentally friendly, low-toxicity dimethenamid-P herbicide offers broad crop applicability and regulatory advantages. In new materials, the company provides high-quality C5 chemical products with import substitution capability. Its extensive overseas pesticide registration network and local market knowledge enhance its global competitiveness.
